summary: All 63 files in TNLean/MPS/Core/ contain formal mathematical content (definitions, theorems, lemmas, proofs) related to tensor networks and matrix product states. Every file was inspected and found to contain Lean 4 formalizations of mathematical results from the tensor network literature with explicit paper citations. No files are pure import aggregators, documentation-only, or lacking mathematical content. All files should remain in the primary search index.
